description: Score a planned spend before an agent pays. Verdicts: approve, ask_human, or block.
name: SpendGate

tools.name: score_spend
tools.description: Score a planned payment before sending it. Call this before any tool that transfers crypto, buys a gift card, starts a subscription, or pays an API or merchant. Pass amount in USD, category, merchant or endpoint URL, and any budget remaining. Returns score 0-100, verdict approve | ask_human | block, reasons, and recommended_action.

amount.description: Planned spend in USD, not in token atomic units.

category.description: One of status_check, api_call, saas, infra, gift_card, crypto_transfer, irreversible. Unknown categories are scored as unknown risk.

purpose.description: Short human description. Used as the category when category is omitted.

merchant.description: Merchant name or https endpoint URL that will receive the spend.

endpoint.description: Alias of merchant when the payee is an API URL.

agent_id.description: Your agent or key id. Echoed, not scored in v1.

api_key.description: Optional SpendGate key (sg_live_…). Anonymous callers share a smaller daily cap.

daily_budget_remaining.description: USD still available today. Amount above this is blocked.

monthly_budget_remaining.description: USD still available this month. Amount above this is blocked.

risk_hints.description: Self-reported hints. Raising: new_payee, new_merchant, first_payment, high_velocity, mismatched_purpose, off_platform, shared_wallet. Lowering: trusted_repeat, within_policy, human_preapproved. known_merchant marks the payee known.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: Read how many free SpendGate scores remain today for this anonymous caller or API key. Does not consume a score and is not billed.

api_key.description: Optional sg_live_ key. Omit to read the anonymous quota for this client.

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Mint a free SpendGate API key. The secret is returned once. Store it and send it as Authorization: Bearer, or as api_key on later score_spend calls. Do not call this on every turn.

label.description: Optional label stored with the key, up to 80 characters.

author: toolweather
